memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic kidney disease stage 3a with osteoarthritis of both knees.
Patient reports mild fatigue and occasional knee pain on walking; denies dyspnea or chest pain. Examination shows BP 138/86, pulse 78, lungs clear, abdomen soft, no peripheral edema, knees tender medially with mild crepitus. Smoking status: former, 10 pack-years, quit 2010. Plan: start telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD; paracetamol 650 mg SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium with vitamin D3 OD. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.42 mg/dL (0.60-1.30); eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60); urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 85 mg/g (<30); haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12.0-15.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic kidney disease stage 3a, stable; osteoarthritis symptomatic.
Patient notes improved energy, occasional knee ache after long drives; no edema or dyspnea. Exam: BP 132/84, pulse 80, lungs clear, abdomen soft, no edema, knees mildly tender, full range of motion. Smoking status: former, 10 pack-years, quit 2010. Plan: continue current CKD meds; check labs; reinforce knee exercises; continue paracetamol SOS and topical diclofenac.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: joint space narrowing medial compartment, osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis – consistent with moderate osteoarthritis. No fracture or effusion.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been having more pain in my right knee after long shifts; it sometimes wakes me at night. The gel helps a bit but I worry about driving safely.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up visit booked for 2025-11-15 at 10:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis worsening, CKD stable.
Patient reports increased right‑knee pain limiting driving; occasional paracetamol use. Exam: BP 130/82, pulse 78, lungs clear, abdomen soft, no edema, right knee tender with mild effusion, crepitus. Smoking status: former, 10 pack-years, quit 2010. Plan: continue CKD meds; add supervised physiotherapy; continue paracetamol SOS and topical diclofenac; consider intra‑articular steroid if no improvement.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
CKD stage 3a, mild decline; osteoarthritis managed.
Patient feels better with physio, knee pain less frequent; no new symptoms. Exam: BP 128/80, pulse 76, lungs clear, abdomen soft, no edema, knees mildly tender, full ROM. Smoking status: former, 10 pack-years, quit 2010. Plan: repeat labs; continue current meds; encourage weight‑bearing exercise within limits.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic kidney disease stable; osteoarthritis controlled.
Patient reports no knee pain limiting work; occasional paracetamol for mild discomfort. Exam: BP 130/84, pulse 78, lungs clear, abdomen soft, no edema, knees non‑tender, full ROM. Smoking status: former, 10 pack-years, quit 2010. Plan: continue telmisartan 80 mg, dapagliflozin 10 mg, furosemide 20 mg, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD; calcium‑vit D3 OD; cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD; paracetamol SOS; topical diclofenac BD. Review in 4 months.
